==Biography==
===2016 Season===
Clid joined [[Newbee Young]] in January of 2016. The team had a mediocre showing during the [[LSPL/2016 Season/Spring Season|2016 LSPL Spring Season]], finishing 6th during the regular season and missing out on playoffs. During the [[LSPL/2016 Season/Summer Season|2016 LSPL Summer Season]], however, the team dominated the league and finished 1st in both the regular season and playoffs, qualifying for the LPL. Because the Newbee organization already had a team in the LPL, the Newbee Young team had to change organizations. They rebranded to [[QG Reapers]].

===2017 Season===
Clid remained on QG Reapers for the [[LPL/2017 Season/Spring Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]] and started for every game except one. The team placed 3rd in their group, but in playoffs lost 2-3 to [[I May]] in the first round. In May 2017, [[JD Gaming]] acquired the team's roster and LPL spot. Although Clid remained with the team, he split play time with the team's other jungler, [[Xinyi]], and only played for a few games of the [[Demacia_Cup/2017_Season|2017 Demacia Cup]] and [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|2017 LPL Summer Season]]. JD Gaming had poor showings in both tournaments, finishing 11th-12th in the former and 5th in group in the latter. They also placed 2nd at the [[National Electronic Sports Tournament 2017]], although Clid did not play in that tournament. At the end of the season, Xinyi left the team, but the team picked up rookie jungler [[xiaohan (Pan Han)|xiaohan]] as a replacement to share play time with Clid.
